title: Charisma TV Anime Reveals January 7 Debut in Teaser Video
content:
The staff for the television anime of Evil Line Records label ( Hypnosis Mic ) and the intellectual property company Dazed's Chōjin-teki Share House Story Charisma (Superhuman Shared Residence Story: Charisma) project began streaming the anime's teaser promotional video on Sunday. The video reveals the anime will debut on January 7.

The series will debut on January 7 on TBS and 27 other affiliate channels and will air on Thursdays at 11:56 p.m.

The staff also revealed two new cast members on Sunday. Shinnosuke Tachibana voices Sōemon Nakakami and Tomohiro Ōno voices Shū Torahime.

In addition, a separate short anime series will debut on November 4 on TBS , and will air on Wednesdays at 11:56 p.m. within TBS 's Yoru no Brunch program.

Jōji Furuta ( Bad Girl , ēlDLIVE , Utano☆Princesama Legend Star , 2021 Shaman King ) is directing the anime at Pierrot Films . Original creator Shū Matsubara is overseeing and writing the series scripts, and Evil Line Records is in charge of music. Along with Matsubara, Dazed is credited for the original work, and Ebimo is credited for the original character designs. TBS Television is the production manager.

Additional staff includes:

• Character Design: Haru Watanabe

• Chief Animation Directors: Haru Watanabe, Seung Ah Han

• Art Director: Seiki Tamura

• Color Key Artist: Yukiko Kakita

• Compositing Director of Photography: Tōru Fukushi

• Editor: Kumiko Sakamoto

• Music: Gesshoku Kaigi

• Sound Directors: Kyōko Wada, Shū Matsubara

• Sound Production: Rakuonsha

• Producers: Kotaro Sudo, Soichiro Hirano, Yoshihiro Tominaga

Evil Line Records and Dazed launched the original project in 2021, and the project revolves around 2D characters who embody "charisma" — in the original sense of the term, which means divinely gifted elemental traits. They stay in a share house (a residence with some shared facilities, such as the kitchen) while aspiring for even higher goals.

Confirmed cast members reprising roles for the anime include:

• Katsumi Fukuhara as Iori Motohashi, the charisma of obedience

• Kenta Hosoda as Kei Sarukawa, the charisma of rebellion

• Saku Hyūga as Ohse Minato, the charisma of internal punishment

• Genki Okawa as Terra, the charisma of self-love

• Tomohisa Hashizume as Amahiko Tendō, the charisma of sex

The project has already spawned musical releases and live concerts. Rin Manda and Iori Irino serialized the four-panel manga Charisma: Kyō mo Heiwa Desu in Kodansha 's Dessert magazine in January 2023 to December 2024 with two volumes compiled, and Sō Tobita serialized the Charisma: Charisma na Karera wa Charisma House de Karizumai-chū manga on Kodansha 's Comic Days site from February to December 2023 with two volumes compiled.
author: ANN

title: Rock is a Lady's Modesty's Hiroshi Fukuda Launches New Manga
content:
The 108th issue of Nihonbungeisha 's Comic Heaven magazine announced on Friday Hiroshi Fukuda will launch a new manga titled Koko wa Kagari no Territory (Here is Kagari's Territory) in the next issue on November 30.

The announcement teases a story around identity and mystery with the tagline: "The biggest mystery for me now is the girl who .... me."

Fukuda ( Mushibugyō , Gofun-go no Sekai ) launched the Rock is a Lady’s Modesty ( Rock wa Lady no Tashinamideshite ) manga in Young Animal in October 2022. Hakusensha published the manga's first compiled book volume in April 2023 and the eighth volume on August 2025.

The series entered a hiatus in July 2025.

The television anime premiered in April 2025 on TBS and 27 of its affiliate channels. HIDIVE streamed the series as it aired. HIDIVE is streaming an English dub .

title: Acorn UK Blu-ray of Hell Mode Listed on Amazon for January
content:
Acorn had previously released two anime Blu-rays on October 26: My Gift Lvl 9999 Unlimited Gacha: Backstabbed in a Backwater Dungeon, I'm Out for Revenge! and Sword of the Demon Hunter . The title is described as follows:

"When a bored 35-year-old hardcore gamer decides to play a new game's notorious “ Hell Mode ” he finds himself reborn as Allen, a small child in a family of serfs living a desperate life in another world! It's a game in name only where winning is simply continuing to survive, and the odds are stacked against them. Allen's one hope? These mysterious “summoning skills” he's been granted, but he has no idea how to use them, he's just a little kid, and since this is a real world, there are no cheat sheets or instruction manuals. The most difficult game ever has begun in Hell Mode !"

Masato Tamagawa ( Saint Seiya: Saintia Shō , The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt , The Great Cleric ) directed the anime at Yokohama Animation Lab . Daishiro Tanimura ( Magical Destroyers ) was in charge of the series scripts. Kei Tsushima ( The Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These ) designed the characters. Misaki Tsuchida , Moyu Kanazaki , Junko Nakajima , Kanade Sakuma , Reiko Abe , Kaho Sawada , BeauDamian , and Tsugumi Tanaka all composed the music.

The band Atarayo performed the opening theme song "Haku," and singer Kaya performed the ending theme song "Sanctuary."
author: ANN

title: Fool Night Anime Streams in India on November 26
content:
Netflix is listing the television anime of Kasumi Yasuda 's Fool Night manga for release in India on November 26. Netflix will debut the entire series worldwide on November 26.

Atsuyuki Yukawa ( Suzume unit director) is directing the anime at Sunrise and SHAFT . Jin Tanaka ( Oshi no Ko ) is writing the script. Robert Satō is designing the characters. Tatsuya Katō ( Dr. Stone ) is composing the music.

Other staff members include:

• Assistant Director: Ryō Shimura

• Visual Development: Ryō Kikuchi

• Art Director: Maki Takano (J.C. Staff)

• Color Design: Jin Hibino

• Director of Photography: Mana Ishikawa (animocaramel), Chiaki Tokuda (Tera Effect), Takayuki Aizu (SHAFT)

• CG Directors: Naoki Yamamoto, Junya Hirano

• Editing: Rie Matsubara (Seyama Editing Room)

• Sound Director: Yōta Tsuruoka

Viz Media licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Kamiya is at the end of his rope. His mother is ill, and his job barely pays for her medication, much less food. With few options left, he considers the life-changing process of transfloration. Ready to give his body up for a payday, Kamiya is about to explore the limits of society's waning humanity.

Yasuda launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Big Comic Superior magazine in November 2020. Shogakukan released the manga's 13th compiled book volume on June 30.

The manga ranked #12 in the male reader list of the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook.
author: ANN

title: Indian Manga Duo masterlynx's Kung Fu Kung Fool Manga Releases in English
content:
KadoComi 's " Kadokawa World Manga" label dedicated to English releases of ongoing manga series released Indian manga creator duo masterlynx's Kung Fu Kung Fool manga in English on Friday.

The label offers the opening and latest chapters of selected series for free in English for international audiences. The company also stated the label is also a publishing platform for " Kadokawa World Manga Atelier," the publisher's initiative "dedicating to discovering and supporting international creators to develop original works."

Kung Fu Kung Fool launched on Kadokawa 's KadoComi website on May 15. The website releases a chapter of the manga on the third Friday of every month. The manga's first compiled volume will ship in Japan on November 6.

The manga went on break in October and will be back on November 6. masterlynx stated the break was so they could work on the upcoming release of the manga's first compiled volume. masterlynx had previously announced on August 26 that they had taken a short hiatus due to health issues, but the manga's chapter releases remained on schedule.

Kadokawa describes Kung Fu Kung Fool :

Goemon, a notorious thief who's been causing a stir in town, clashes with the Whiskers, a gang of villains, over the treasure held by a young boy named Bao. Just when he's cornered and desperate, Goemon's second personality awakens — unleashing instinctive kung fu attacks that take down his enemies... What awaits Goemon and Bao on their goofy adventure?! A nonstop action comedy begins!

The manga creators hail from Amravati in Maharashtra. The self-taught team comprises of brothers, Jivan and Yash, who have been creating manga for four years. They began drawing manga in 2022 and have freelanced as amateur manga artists since then. The duo entered Kadokawa 's Wordless World Manga Contest in 2025 and won the Silver Prize with their one-shot Heartsteel .

For Kung Fu Kung Fool , masterlynx has been working closely with their editor to bring the story to life in Japanese. The team discuss the story and scenes together and then work on the dialogue collaboratively in English. “We keep refining it until we are satisfied with it,” stated masterlynx, “After that, our editor, Mr. O, translates the dialogue into Japanese for serialization.”
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Streams Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3 Anime in India in January 2027
content:
Crunchyroll announced on Thursday that it will stream Mashle: Magic and Muscles - Tri-Magicathalon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc , the third season based on Hajime Kōmoto 's Mashle: Magic and Muscles manga, in January in January 2027.

Returning cast members include:

• Chiaki Kobayashi as Mash Burnedead

• Kaito Ishikawa as Lance Crown

• Reiji Kawashima as Finn Ames

• Reina Ueda as Lemon Irvine

• Takuya Eguchi as Dot Barrett

Confirmed returning staff members include director Tomoya Tanaka at A-1 Pictures , scriptwriter and series composition writer Yōsuke Kuroda , and composer Masaru Yokoyama . Chiaki Furuzumi (chief animation director and sub-character designer for Solo Leveling both seasons) is replacing Hisashi Higashijima as the character designer.

The anime's first season premiered in Japan in April 2023 and aired for 12 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed it in India as it aired in Japan and began streaming a Hindi dub in May 2023. It began streaming Tamil and Telugu dubs for the season in May 2024. The second season premiered in January 2024 and aired for 12 episodes. The Tamil and Telugu dubs of the anime premiered on August 20. Crunchyroll also streamed a Hindi dub for the season. Amazon's Animax channel and Sony LIV are also streaming the anime.

The overall anime project is listed as a "complete" anime adaptation.

Both Viz Media 's Shonen Jump service and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service published the manga digitally in English. Viz Media is also releasing the manga in print. Shueisha describes the manga:

This is a world of magic where magic is used for everything. But deep in the forest exists a young man who spends his time training and bulking up. He can't use magic, but he enjoys a peaceful life with his father. But one day, his life is put in danger! Will his muscular body protect him from the magic users who are out to get him? Powerfully trained muscles crush magic as this abnormal magical fantasy begins!

The series launched in Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in Japan in January 2020, and ended in July 2023. Shueisha published the manga's 18th and final compiled book volume, as well as a fanbook, in October 2023. The franchise also includes several novels and two stage play adaptations .

Mashle : Muscle Puzzle , a smartphone puzzle game in the franchise , launched in April 2025.

title: Three Ghibli Blu-ray Steelbooks Listed For December 7
content:
The home releases bear the GKIDS logo.

Each will be released in multiple formats: a standard DVD edition; a standard Blu-ray edition; a Steelbook edition which will carry the respective films on both Blu-ray and DVD discs; and a Collector's Edition which will also include the film on Blu-ray and DVD, as well as other extras. (Each of the Collector's Editions will include four art cards, a poster and a booklet.) The pictures are of the Collector's Editions.

My Neighbor Totoro is described as follows:

"When Satsuki and her sister Mei move with their father to a new home in the countryside, they find country life is not as simple as it seems. They soon discover that the house and nearby woods are full of strange and delightful creatures, including a gigantic but gentle forest spirit called Totoro , who can only be seen by children. Totoro and his friends introduce the girls to a series of adventures, including a ride aboard the extraordinary Cat Bus, in this all-ages animated masterpiece featuring the voices of Tim Daly, Lea Salonga , and real-life sisters Dakota and Elle Fanning , in early roles."

"“ Porco Rosso ” is a world-weary flying ace-turned-bounty-hunter, whose face has been transformed into that of a pig by a mysterious spell. When he infuriates a band of sky pirates with his heroics, the pirates hire Curtis, a hotshot American rival, to get rid of him. But with the help of the teenage girl Fio, an aspiring airplane designer, and a sultry lounge singer named Gina, Porco takes to the skies for what may be his final high-flying showdown."

"Chihiro's family is moving to a new house, but when they stop on the way to explore an abandoned village, her parents undergo a mysterious transformation and Chihiro is whisked into a world of fantastic spirits ruled over by the sorceress Yubaba. Put to work in a magical bathhouse for spirits and demons, Chihiro must use all her wits to survive in this strange new place, find a way to free her parents and return to the normal world. Overflowing with imaginative creatures and thrilling storytelling, Spirited Away became a worldwide smash hit, and is one of the most critically-acclaimed films of all time."

title: Idoly Pride Game Ends Service on March 1
content:
The official Twitter account for the Idoly Pride multimedia project announced on Friday the game will end service on March 1. The game will update with an offline version.

The original game launched in June 2021 for iOS and Android devices.

Hiroki Haruse ended the Idoly Pride: Stage of Asterism manga with the third volume in January 2022. Haruse launched the manga in Comic Newtype in June 2020.

The Idoly Pride anime premiered on Tokyo MX and other channels in January 2021 and ended in March of the same year. Funimation streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

The anime was CAAnimation 's first project. CyberAgent , the parent company of game developer Cygames and streaming service company AbemaTV , founded the CAAnimation label in October 2018.

CyberAgent subsidiary QualiArts , Straight Edge , and Music Ray'n collaborated on the multimedia project. QP:flapper ( Girlish Number , Girl Friend BETA ) provided the original character designs. Yoshiki MIZUSUMI (name romanization not confirmed) of QualiArts , Kaoru Adachi ( Love Live! School idol project producer) of Straight Edge , and Jukki Hanada ( Love Live! School idol project , Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions! scripts) of SATZ are credited with the original concept. Music Ray'n and QualiArts are credited for the music.
author: ANN

title: 'Shibatsuki Bukken' Gets TV Anime Adaptation in Summer 2027
content:
Publishing company Shueisha announced a television anime adaptation of Esu Omori 's Shibatsuki Bukken ( Shiba Inu Rooms ) on Sunday. An official website also opened and revealed the main staff, cast, a teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video. The anime is scheduled to air in Summer 2027.

Voice actresses Niina Nakabayashi ( Awajima Hyakkei ) and Mutsumi Tamura ( Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon ) are starring as Koori Momose and Muu, respectively.

Osamu Yamasaki ( Seirei Gensouki , Itazura na Kiss ) directs the anime at TMS Entertainment and Rio ( Trapezium , Majutsushi Orphen Hagure Tabi: Urbanrama-hen ) is designing the characters.

Esu Omori originally penned Shibatsuki Bukken as a one-shot on Shueisha's Shonen Jump+ magazine in July 2023, followed by a manga serialization on the same platform, which began in June 2024. The eighth volume was released on August 4, with the ninth volume scheduled to go on sale on November 4, 2026.

VIZ Media licenses the manga in English under the title Shiba Inu Rooms and is available digitally through VIZ Media's Shonen Jump service and Shuesha's MANGA plus platform.

Synopsis Spacious apartment in a new building, an expansive kitchen with an induction stove, a bathroom with a separated toilet, and even a washroom, all for just... 4,800 yen a month?! But there is a spooky reason Maison Shiba is so doggone affordable.

content:
Wright Film announced on Sunday that Esu Omori 's Shiba Inu Rooms ( Shiba-tsuki Bukken ) manga is getting a television anime series that will debut in summer 2027. The staff said the anime was announced on Sunday as November 1 was "Wan Wan Wan Day" ("Wan" being the sound of a dog barking in Japanese).

The anime will star:

Omori also drew an illustration to commemorate the news.

Osamu Yamasaki is directing the anime at TMS Entertainment . Rio ( trapezium , Sorcerous Stabber Orphen -Chaos in Urbanrama- ) is designing the characters.

Viz Media licensed the manga for digital release in January 2025, and then announced a physical release in February 2026. The company shipped the first volume in print on September 1.

Viz Media describes the story:

After moving in, high schooler Kori finds out her apartment is haunted by Mu, a Shiba Inu ghost. Like fire and ice, Kori and Mu are at odds. Can the two learn to co-exist, and even become friends?

The series is also available digitally in English on the MANGA Plus app.

The manga first launched as a one-shot in 2023, and then as a serialization on Shonen Jump+ in June 2024. Shueisha will publish the ninth volume on November 4.
